label: Spanish
source_guidance: Interpret omitted Spanish subjects, tense and tú/usted register. Distinguish grammatical gender from facts about characters.
target_guidance: Use natural Spanish with consistent tense, gender/number agreement and forms of address. Preserve accents.
punctuation_rule: Use Spanish punctuation, including paired ¿? and ¡!. Preserve dialogue and other symbol structure and pairing.
title_rule: Use natural Spanish titles and section labels with conventional capitalization.
term_guidance: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
